items.reason: Describes client removal throwing UnsupportedOperationException when both V1 and V2 are enabled. Issue #01 concerns skipped cleanup when V1 is disabled; fixing that gate does not fix this exception.
Identifies the same incorrect boolean-return Javadoc on the two void requireView methods.
Identifies the same missing global MANAGE check in parameterless canView(), with additional consequences for callers.
Identifies the same unused private getEvaluationContext method; the additional unused members do not change the match.

Describes insufficient isolation of role-mapping scopes in testMapRolesAndCompositesOnlyOneClient. This differs from #11's default-scope removal assertion being satisfied by a preceding forbidden read.

The broader unsupported-method regression explicitly includes canExchangeTo throwing under V2. AbstractTokenExchangeProvider still calls that method, confirming the token-exchange failure described by #opa-02.
